correctness.rationale: For all finite fields, polynomial coefficient expansion produces 93 by 100 integer matrix with exact unimodular 59 by 59 minor. Standard solutions supply 41-dimensional kernel, giving exact formal rank 59 in all characteristics; polynomial interpolation applies for any q>2 because each variable has individual degree at most 2. For F2, Boolean reduction produces 83 by 100 matrix with nonsingular 55 by 55 minor, while 41 standard plus four independently checked exceptional maps form 45 independent solutions, hence exact dimension 45. Standalone direct verifier checks all 1024 binary inputs and rank 55. Higher-size explicit examples satisfy the original equation pointwise but their completeness is not claimed.

value.rationale: Exact natural finite-field classification at fixed minimal nontrivial matrix size where a 2-power-commuting condition differs from commuting. A sharp field-size discontinuity adds four unexpected binary maps and yields explicit counterexamples to field-independent standard forms at all matrix sizes n>=5. This establishes a structural limitation of characteristic-zero functional-identity results, not a routine restatement or arbitrary parameter slice.
